name: Kokoro Navi
source:
Main character is a nerd and Internet addict. But one day he receives a love email. He opens the letter for some reason and finds instructions how to launch mysterious browser "Kokoro Navi"...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是个御宅族兼网络成瘾者。一天，他收到了一封情书邮件。不知为何，他打开邮件，发现其中写着如何启动名为“心灵导航”的神秘浏览器…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
